title: Director at Cybersecurity Consulting Firm Expects CrowdStrike-Related Business to Grow 20%–30% in 2026
expert: Director at a global cybersecurity consulting firm (current; first-hand CRWD services revenue and deals)

partner delivery margin ~30% vs ~20% Microsoft and 15%–20% Palo Alto, giving partners a reason to lead with CRWD; first read. → Tenet 4 (core endpoint) ↑
